# Run ledger — P26.5 (the vendor tenant universe: full enumeration + remaining platforms)

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P26.5__vendor-tenant-universe.md` (SOURCES.5).
- **Branch:** `devin/p26-5-vendor-tenant-universe` — stacked on
  `devin/p26-4-credential-ingests` (tip `f6f7973`, PR #96).
- **Date:** 2026-09-17. Engineering under GL-GATE-06 + ADR-087 (4xx robots = no
  policy); every host's robots decides, never bypassed.

## What landed

### 1. Full tenant enumeration — 76 → 793 registered tenant rows

`connectors/src/connectors/data/agenda_tenants.toml` now carries **793**
`[tenants.*]` rows, each with a per-row `enum_source` recording the discovery
channels that produced it (`cc` = Common Crawl index, `ht` = certificate-
transparency/host inventory, `crt` = crt.sh, `wb` = Wayback, `us` = Census
Gazetteer jurisdiction normalisation, `platform_probe` = direct platform
surface enumeration, `p26_3_seed` = the P26.3 curated seed):

| platform | tenant rows | discovery channels |
|---|---|---|
| legistar | 306 | `cc` 216, `cc+us` 25, `cc+ht` 20, `ht` 6, `cc+ht+wb`/`cc+ht+us`/`us` 7, `p26_3_seed` 32 |
| civicclerk | 303 | `platform_probe` 188, `cc` 41, `ht` 33, `cc+ht` 6, `p26_3_seed` 35 |
| primegov | 110 | `crt` 41, `ht` 23, `cc` 16, `crt+ht` 12, `cc+ht`/`cc+crt`/`cc+crt+ht` 9, `p26_3_seed` 9 |
| escribe | 74 | `ht` 47, `platform_probe` 22, `cc`/`cc+ht` 5 |

Enumeration filtering removed DNS-only artifacts, staging/test slugs
(`production`, `support`, `techsupport`), person-name slugs, URL-encoded
garbage, and non-jurisdiction hosts — excluded candidates are preserved in the
platform census, never silently dropped (§3.1).

### 2. Platform census — the found-but-not-ingested universe (1,055 rows)

New `[[platform_census]]` section records every enumerated candidate that is
NOT a live target, with `host`, `platform`, `outcome`, `enum_source` —
the honest negative space of the enumeration (SIG-METRIC-002a):

| outcome | rows | platforms |
|---|---|---|
| `no_bounded_api` | 426 | CivicPlus AgendaCenter (HTML-only portal), NovusAGENDA (WebForms `__doPostBack`, no bounded JSON), IQM2, BoardDocs |
| `robots_disallow_all` | 367 | Granicus (`{tenant}.granicus.com` answers `Disallow: /` platform-wide), plus walled PrimeGov-class hosts |
| `unreachable` | 186 | DNS-resolving but connection-refused/timeout hosts |
| `non_jurisdiction_host` | 30 | vendor infra, docs, staging, person-name/test slugs |
| `redirect` | 19 | hosts 301/302-ing away from the platform surface |
| `access_restricted` | 15 | 403/auth walls |
| `not_provisioned` | 12 | Legistar InSite "client not provisioned" envelopes |

Per platform: granicus 434, civicplus 355, novusagenda 156, iqm2 57,
primegov 30, legistar 12, boarddocs 11. A census host is NEVER expanded into
a live target — `tenant_targets()` reads only `[tenants.*]` (test-pinned).

### 3. eScribe — a fifth agenda platform, discovered and ingested

The P26.5 sweep found **eScribe** (`pub-{tenant}.escribemeetings.com`): the
tenant's own public calendar page calls the ASP.NET JSON webmethod
`POST …/MeetingsCalendarView.aspx/GetCalendarMeetings`, answering
`{"d": […meeting records…]}` — a real bounded per-tenant surface.

- `procurement.py`: the platform envelope key is now data — `items_key` on the
  reviewed `[platform_endpoints.*]` row (`"d"` for eScribe) — plus eScribe field
  aliases (`ID`, `Guid`, `MeetingName`, `MeetingType`, `StartDate`) so the
  existing agenda_index/meeting-body shapes emit unchanged claims. No new
  connector class; no new claim kinds (no semantic scope creep).
- `sources.toml`: `escribe` flipped `ingestion_permitted=true` under
  **GL-GATE-06** — municipal meeting records are public records → CC0-1.0, the
  same basis as `legistar`/`civicclerk`/`okc_council` (packet:
  `docs/build/reports/rights/escribe.md`). `granicus` registered as a gated
  LINK/`not_contacted` discovery row — the census preserves it as
  `robots_disallow_all`/`no_bounded_api`.
- Fixture + tests: `tests/connectors/fixtures/promoted/escribe_victoria_meetings.json`
  (a real `{"d":[…]}` payload) drives `test_escribe_meetings_index_over_fixture`;
  `test_platform_census_rows_are_enumerated_never_targets` pins that census
  hosts never become targets.

## Decisions / deviations

- **eScribe flip** rides the same GL-GATE-06 municipal-public-record basis as
  the P26.2 agenda-platform flips — the packet records the reasoning; if the
  operator disagrees the row flips back and the census rows already preserve
  the hosts.
- **PrimeGov stays refused.** All 110 enumerated tenants answer
  `Disallow: /` (or serve no robots → unretrievable). The ADR-083-style
  API-mode decision for the PublicPortal surface remains the operator's call —
  the ticket records refusals, it does not bypass them.
- **Fixture-replay politeness.** `runner.py` fixture paths
  (`run_connector_over_fixture`, `_run_over_fixture`) now inject a
  no-real-sleep `RateLimiter` — a static-transport replay opens no socket, so
  the per-host politeness bookkeeping still runs but must not burn real seconds
  across a 300-target fan-out (was ~5 min/test, now seconds). Live runs are
  untouched — the real limiter still sleeps.
- **`test_review_status`/registry counts** updated for 144 registered /
  44 loadable; the `escribe` live-op disposition row moved out of
  `live_dispositions.toml` (it is connector-mapped now — one disposition each);
  `granicus` took its `link_only` row.

## Honest limits

- 89 tenant rows carry an unresolved jurisdiction string
  (`"<slug> (<platform> tenant — unresolved)"`) — the host verified but the
  jurisdiction name could not be grounded to a Census-gazetteer entity; the
  label says so rather than fabricating a name (§3.1).
- Granicus, CivicPlus, NovusAGENDA, IQM2, BoardDocs, iCompass/Compilatio are
  enumerated-negatives only — no bounded public API was found, and Granicus's
  robots wall stands. They live in `platform_census`, never in `live_targets`.
- Legistar's four `access_restricted` disappearances may include shared-host
  rate-limiting; they are recorded as observed, per-tenant.
